title: Partial Derivation
html: A partial derivation is a list of lines laid out as a derivation (@def-derivation), except that some stretches of lines are still missing. Each missing stretch is a gap, drawn as a row ⋮. The line just below a gap is its current goal; it is already written, but it has no justification yet, since the lines of the gap are to supply one. The lines available at the current goal, in the sense of @def-derivation, are the gap’s resources.
